items.title: Benchtop monocular laboratory microscope
items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import math


def clinical_monocular_microscope():
    base = base_part()
    carriage = carriage_part()
    stage = stage_part()
    turret = turret_part()
    c0 = stage_control_0_part()
    c1 = stage_control_1_part()
    f = s3d.local(base, 0, -32, 105)
    carriage = s3d.at(carriage, on=f)
    s3d.joint("base_to_carriage", carriage, f, kind="prismatic", axis="+Z", range=(0, 75))
    f = s3d.local(carriage, 0, 72, 0)
    stage = s3d.at(stage, on=f)
    s3d.joint("carriage_to_stage", stage, f, kind="prismatic", axis="+Y", range=(-18, 18))
    f = s3d.local(carriage, 0, 94, 74, 32, 0, 0)
    turret = s3d.at(turret, on=f)
    s3d.joint("carriage_to_turret", turret, f, kind="continuous", axis="normal")
    f = s3d.local(carriage, 40, 72, 0)
    c0 = s3d.at(c0, on=f)
    s3d.joint("carriage_to_stage_control_0", c0, f, kind="continuous", axis="+X")
    c1 = s3d.at(c1, on=f)
    s3d.joint("carriage_to_stage_control_1", c1, f, kind="continuous", axis="+X")
    return s3d.assembly("clinical_monocular_microscope", base, carriage, stage, turret, c0, c1)

    return s3d.group(
        "base",

items.title: Louvered shutter assembly
items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import math


def vent_shutter_insert():
    frame = frame_part()
    bar = linkage_bar()
    f = s3d.local(frame, 136, 0, 9)
    bar = s3d.at(bar, on=f)
    s3d.joint("frame_to_linkage_bar", bar, f, kind="prismatic", axis="+Y", range=(-10, 10))
    knob = control_knob()
    f = s3d.local(frame, 156, 0, 0)
    knob = s3d.at(knob, on=f)
    s3d.joint(
        "frame_to_knob",
        knob,
        f,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="+Z",
        range=(-1.2 * 180 / math.pi, 1.2 * 180 / math.pi),
    )
    parts = [frame, bar, knob]
    for i, y in enumerate((57, 19, -19, -57), 1):
        l = louver()
        f = s3d.local(frame, 0, y, 24)
        l = s3d.at(l, on=f)
        s3d.joint(
            f"frame_to_louver_{i}",
            l,
            f,
            kind="revolute",
            axis="+X",
            range=(-0.55 * 180 / math.pi, 0.70 * 180 / math.pi),
        )
        parts.append(l)
    return s3d.assembly("vent_shutter_insert", *parts)


def boxv(name, size, pos, kind, color):
    o = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
    o = s3d.at(o, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2])
    return s3d.material(o, kind, color=color)


def cylv(name, r, l, pos, rot, kind, color):
    o = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True)
    o = s3d.at(o, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2], rx=rot[0], ry=rot[1], rz=rot[2])
    return s3d.material(o, kind, color=color)


def frame_part():
    a = []

    def add(n, s, p, c=0):
        a.append(
            boxv(n, s, p, "aluminium" if c == 0 else "steel", "#d4d9de" if c == 0 else "#9ea6ad")
        )

    add("left_rail", (28, 240, 42), (-156, 0, 24))
    add("top_rail", (284, 34, 42), (0, 103, 24))
    add("bottom_rail", (284, 34, 42), (0, -103, 24))
    add("right_inner_strip", (8, 240, 31), (146, 0, 29.5), 1)
    add("right_outer_upper", (20, 100, 42), (160, 70, 24))
    add("right_outer_lower", (20, 100, 42), (160, -70, 24))
    add("top_flange", (340, 18, 3), (0, 111, 1.5), 1)
    add("bottom_flange", (340, 18, 3), (0, -111, 1.5), 1)
    add("left_flange", (18, 204, 3), (-161, 0, 1.5), 1)
    add("right_upper_flange", (18, 70, 3), (161, 67, 1.5), 1)
    add("right_lower_flange", (18, 70, 3), (161, -67, 1.5), 1)
    add("knob_bushing_upper", (28, 12, 10), (156, 14, 5), 1)
    add("knob_bushing_lower", (28, 12, 10), (156, -14, 5), 1)
    for pre, y in [("upper", 68), ("lower", -68)]:
        add(f"linkage_{pre}_guide_front", (8, 18, 2), (136, y, 6), 1)
        add(f"linkage_{pre}_guide_back", (8, 18, 3), (136, y, 12.5), 1)
        add(f"linkage_{pre}_guide_rib", (2, 18, 9), (141, y, 9.5), 1)
    for i, y in enumerate((57, 19, -19, -57), 1):
        add(f"left_clip_{i}", (7, 14, 4), (-138.5, y, 16), 1)
        add(f"right_clip_{i}", (7, 14, 4), (138.5, y, 16), 1)
    return s3d.group("frame", *a)


def linkage_bar():
    a = [boxv("bar", (6, 156, 4), (0, 0, 0), "steel", "#40454d")]
    for i, y in enumerate((57, 19, -19, -57), 1):
        a.append(boxv(f"paddle_{i}", (6, 8, 4), (-6, y, 0), "steel", "#40454d"))
    a.append(boxv("drive_tab", (8, 18, 4), (7, 0, 0), "steel", "#40454d"))
    return s3d.group("linkage_bar", *a)


def control_knob():
    return s3d.group(
        "control_knob",
        cylv("grip", 15, 10, (0, 0, -6), (0, 0, 0), "rubber", "#1a1c1f"),
        cylv("collar", 9.5, 2, (0, 0, -1), (0, 0, 0), "steel", "#40454d"),
        cylv("shaft", 4.5, 12, (0, 0, 4.5), (0, 0, 0), "steel", "#40454d"),
        boxv("drive_arm", (10, 4, 3), (-1, 0, 10), "steel", "#40454d"),
        boxv("drive_pin", (8, 10, 3), (-5, 0, 10), "steel", "#40454d"),
    )


def louver():
    hc = 16.5
    ht = 3
    pts = [
        (0, -hc),
        (ht * 0.45, -hc * 0.74),
        (ht * 0.92, -hc * 0.22),
        (ht * 0.72, hc * 0.34),
        (ht * 0.25, hc),
        (-ht * 0.28, hc * 0.62),
        (-ht * 0.82, -hc * 0.10),
        (-ht * 0.42, -hc * 0.72),
    ]
    blade = s3d.extrude("blade", s3d.poly(pts), 252, both=True)
    blade = s3d.at(blade, ry=90)
    blade = s3d.material(blade, "aluminium", color="#c2c9d1")
    return s3d.group(
        "louver",
        blade,
        cylv("left_hub", 6, 8, (-130, 0, 0), (0, 90, 0), "steel", "#9ea6ad"),
        cylv("right_hub", 6, 8, (130, 0, 0), (0, 90, 0), "steel", "#9ea6ad"),
        cylv("left_pin", 3.5, 8, (-138, 0, 0), (0, 90, 0), "steel", "#40454d"),
        cylv("right_pin", 3.5, 8, (138, 0, 0), (0, 90, 0), "steel", "#40454d"),
        boxv("drive_ear", (10, 4, 10), (121, 0, -10), "steel", "#40454d"),
    )

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d


def passenger_elevator():
    guide = guide_structure()
    car = cab()
    f = s3d.local(guide, 0, 0, 200)
    car = s3d.at(car, on=f)
    s3d.joint("cab_lift", car, f, kind="prismatic", axis="+Z", range=(0, 8000))
    left = left_door()
    f = s3d.local(car, -310, 820, 1110)
    left = s3d.at(left, on=f)
    s3d.joint("left_door_slide", left, f, kind="prismatic", axis="-X", range=(0, 600))
    right = right_door()
    f = s3d.local(car, 310, 820, 1110)
    right = s3d.at(right, on=f)
    s3d.joint("right_door_slide", right, f, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 600))
    return s3d.assembly("passenger_elevator", guide, car, left, right)


def visual_box(name, size, pos, color):
    ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
    ob = s3d.at(ob, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2])
    s3d.material(ob, "plastic", color=color)
    return ob


def visual_cyl(name, radius, length, pos, rot, color):
    ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * radius), length, both=True)
    ob = s3d.at(ob, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2], rx=rot[0], ry=rot[1], rz=rot[2])
    s3d.material(ob, "steel", color=color)
    return ob


def guide_structure():
    rail = 11600
    a = []

    def b(n, s, p, c):
        a.append(visual_box(n, s, p, c))

    b("base_pad", (3500, 3000, 200), (0, 0, 100), "#4d4d4d")
    b("left_rail_base", (20, 100, rail), (-1380, 0, rail / 2 + 200), "#4d4d4d")
    b("left_rail_stem", (60, 20, rail), (-1340, 0, rail / 2 + 200), "#b3b3b3")
    b("right_rail_base", (20, 100, rail), (1380, 0, rail / 2 + 200), "#4d4d4d")
    b("right_rail_stem", (60, 20, rail), (1340, 0, rail / 2 + 200), "#b3b3b3")
    b("back_left_beam", (100, 100, rail), (-1300, -1100, rail / 2 + 200), "#666666")
    b("back_right_beam", (100, 100, rail), (1300, -1100, rail / 2 + 200), "#666666")
    b("top_beam", (3500, 3000, 400), (0, 0, 12000), "#333333")
    a.append(visual_cyl("hoist_pulley", 300, 400, (0, 0, 12600), (0, 90, 0), "#cc801a"))
    return s3d.group("guide_structure", *a)


def cab():
    w, d, h, t = 2600, 1800, 2600, 50
    a = []

    def b(n, s, p, c):
        a.append(visual_box(n, s, p, c))

    b("floor", (w, d, t), (0, 0, 25), "#333333")
    b("floor_finish", (w - 2 * t, d - 2 * t, 10), (0, 0, 55), "#262626")
    b("ceiling", (w, d, t), (0, 0, h - t / 2), "#e6e6e6")
    b("back_wall", (w, t, h - 2 * t), (0, -d / 2 + t / 2, h / 2), "#ccccd9")
    b("left_wall", (t, d - t, h - 2 * t), (-w / 2 + t / 2, 0, h / 2), "#ccccd9")
    b("right_wall", (t, d - t, h - 2 * t), (w / 2 - t / 2, 0, h / 2), "#ccccd9")
    pw = 700
    b("front_left_wall", (pw, t, h - 2 * t), (-w / 2 + pw / 2, d / 2 - t / 2, h / 2), "#b3b3b3")
    b("front_right_wall", (pw, t, h - 2 * t), (w / 2 - pw / 2, d / 2 - t / 2, h / 2), "#b3b3b3")
    b("front_top_wall", (1200, t, 450), (0, d / 2 - t / 2, 2325), "#b3b3b3")
    b("frame_left", (50, 20, 2100), (-625, 910, 1100), "#cccccc")
    b("frame_right", (50, 20, 2100), (625, 910, 1100), "#cccccc")
    b("frame_top", (1300, 20, 50), (0, 910, 2225), "#cccccc")
    b("mirror", (1800, 10, 1200), (0, -895, 1400), "#e6e6f2")
    a.append(visual_cyl("handrail", 20, 2200, (0, -850, 900), (0, 90, 0), "#cccccc"))
    a.append(visual_cyl("handrail_mount_left", 15, 50, (-900, -875, 900), (90, 0, 0), "#cccccc"))
    a.append(visual_cyl("handrail_mount_right", 15, 50, (900, -875, 900), (90, 0, 0), "#cccccc"))
    b("control_panel", (20, 200, 600), (1240, 0, 1200), "#1a1a1a")
    for x, n in [(-100, "hoist_cable_1"), (100, "hoist_cable_2")]:
        a.append(visual_cyl(n, 20, 11600, (x, 0, 8400), (0, 0, 0), "#1a1a1a"))
    for z in (400, 2200):
        for sign, prefix in ((-1, "left"), (1, "right")):
            b(f"{prefix}_shoe_mount_{z}", (10, 120, 150), (sign * 1305, 0, z), "#333333")
            b(f"{prefix}_shoe_front_{z}", (60, 20, 150), (sign * 1340, 20, z), "#333333")
            b(f"{prefix}_shoe_back_{z}", (60, 20, 150), (sign * 1340, -20, z), "#333333")
    return s3d.group("cab", *a)


def left_door():
    return s3d.group("left_door", visual_box("panel", (610, 40, 2100), (0, 0, 0), "#9999a6"))


def right_door():
    return s3d.group("right_door", visual_box("panel", (610, 40, 2100), (0, 0, 0), "#9999a6"))

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def floor_double_door_switchboard():
    body = body_part()
    door0 = door_0_part()
    door1 = door_1_part()
    bar = swing_bar_part()
    f0 = s3d.local(body, -620 + 6, -180 - 26, 0)
    door0 = s3d.at(door0, on=f0)
    s3d.joint(
        "body_to_door_0", door0, f0, kind="revolute", axis="-Z", range=(0, math.degrees(1.75))
    )
    f1 = s3d.local(body, 620 - 6, -180 - 26, 0)
    door1 = s3d.at(door1, on=f1)
    s3d.joint(
        "body_to_door_1", door1, f1, kind="revolute", axis="+Z", range=(0, math.degrees(1.75))
    )
    fb = s3d.local(door0, 612 - 125, -17.5 - 21, 1200)
    bar = s3d.at(bar, on=fb)
    s3d.joint(
        "door_0_to_swing_bar", bar, fb, kind="revolute", axis="-Y", range=(0, math.degrees(1.35))
    )
    return s3d.assembly("floor_double_door_switchboard", body, door0, door1, bar)


def body_part():
    steel = "#949fa3"
    dark = "#1f2426"
    hinge = "#b8b8ad"

    s3d.material(b, "steel", color=steel)
    c = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("side_sheet_1", s3d.rect(30, 360), 2020, both=True), x=605, z=1010)
    s3d.material(c, "steel", color=steel)
    d = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("top_cap", s3d.rect(1240, 360), 40, both=True), z=2000)
    s3d.material(d, "steel", color=steel)
    e = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("bottom_sill", s3d.rect(1240, 360), 55, both=True), z=27.5)
    s3d.material(e, "steel", color=steel)
    p = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("floor_plinth", s3d.rect(1320, 410), 110, both=True), z=55)
    s3d.material(p, "steel", color=dark)
    h = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("front_header", s3d.rect(1240, 38), 80, both=True), y=-184, z=1960)
    s3d.material(h, "steel", color=steel)
    t = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("front_threshold", s3d.rect(1240, 38), 75, both=True), y=-184, z=135)
    s3d.material(t, "steel", color=steel)
    j = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("center_jamb", s3d.rect(20, 26), 1740, both=True), y=-165, z=1050)
    s3d.material(j, "steel", color=dark)
    parts = [a, b, c, d, e, p, h, t, j]

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def undershot_waterwheel():
    support = support_frame()
    wheel = waterwheel()
    f = s3d.local(support, 0, 0, 1500)
    wheel = s3d.at(wheel, on=f)
    s3d.joint("wheel_spin", wheel, f, kind="continuous", axis="+Y")
    return s3d.assembly("undershot_waterwheel", support, wheel)


def support_frame():
    stone = "#a19c91"
    timber = "#694728"
    weathered = "#8a643d"
    iron = "#3b3d40"
    parts = []

    def box(name, size, pos, mat, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
        ob = s3d.at(ob, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2], rx=rot[0], ry=rot[1], rz=rot[2])
        kind = "steel" if mat == iron else ("painted_metal" if mat == stone else "oak")
        return s3d.material(ob, kind, color=mat)

    def cyl(name, r, l, pos, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True)
        ob = s3d.at(ob, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2], rx=rot[0], ry=rot[1], rz=rot[2])
        return s3d.material(ob, "steel", color=iron)

    parts.append(box("plinth", (2600, 1300, 120), (0, 0, 60), stone))
    parts.append(box("upper_base", (2100, 820, 100), (0, 0, 170), stone))
    for y, side in [(-440, "right"), (440, "left")]:
        parts += [
            box("post_rear_" + side, (140, 120, 1960), (-360, y, 1100), timber),
            box("post_front_" + side, (140, 120, 1960), (360, y, 1100), timber),
            box("cap_" + side, (860, 120, 140), (0, y, 2140), timber),
            box("sill_" + side, (860, 120, 140), (0, y, 480), timber),
            box(
                "brace_rising_" + side,
                (120, 120, 1780),
                (0, y, 1180),
                weathered,
                (0, math.degrees(0.4), 0),
            ),
            box(
                "brace_falling_" + side,
                (120, 120, 1780),
                (0, y, 1180),
                weathered,
                (0, math.degrees(-0.4), 0),
            ),
            box("bearing_block_" + side, (200, 100, 200), (0, y * 0.95, 1500), iron),
        ]
    parts += [
        box("rear_tie_beam", (160, 940, 160), (-360, 0, 2100), timber),
        box("front_tie_beam", (160, 940, 160), (360, 0, 2100), timber),
    ]
    parts += [
        cyl("axle_bed_left", 50, 120, (0, 500, 1500), (90, 0, 0)),
        cyl("axle_bed_right", 50, 120, (0, -500, 1500), (90, 0, 0)),
    ]
    parts += [
        box("race_floor", (980, 740, 80), (-800, 0, 780), weathered),
        box("race_wall_right", (980, 80, 280), (-800, -330, 920), weathered),
        box("race_wall_left", (980, 80, 280), (-800, 330, 920), weathered),
        box("race_lip", (120, 740, 180), (-310, 0, 820), weathered),
        box("race_support_right", (120, 120, 950), (-920, -240, 590), timber),
        box("race_support_left", (120, 120, 950), (-920, 240, 590), timber),
    ]
    return s3d.group("support_frame", *parts)


def waterwheel():
    iron = "#3b3d40"
    wood = "#8a643d"
    p = []

    def box(name, size, pos, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        o = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
        o = s3d.at(o, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2], rx=rot[0], ry=rot[1], rz=rot[2])
        return s3d.material(o, "oak", color=wood)

    def cyl(name, r, l, pos=(0, 0, 0), rot=(90, 0, 0)):
        o = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True)
        o = s3d.at(o, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2], rx=rot[0], ry=rot[1], rz=rot[2])
        return s3d.material(o, "steel", color=iron)

    p += [
        cyl("axle", 45, 736),
        cyl("hub_barrel", 110, 400),
        cyl("hub_plate_left", 160, 60, (0, 170, 0)),
        cyl("hub_plate_right", 160, 60, (0, -170, 0)),
    ]
    for name, y in [("rim_left", 230), ("rim_right", -230)]:
        o = s3d.at(s3d.torus(name, 1000, 60), x=0, y=y, z=0, rx=90)
        p.append(s3d.material(o, "steel", color=iron))
    for i in range(8):
        a = 2 * math.pi * i / 8
        p.append(
            box(
                f"spoke_{i:02d}",
                (50, 440, 380),
                (math.sin(a) * 280, 0, math.cos(a) * 280),
                (0, math.degrees(a), 0),
            )
        )
    for i in range(10):
        a = 2 * math.pi * i / 10
        p.append(
            box(
                f"paddle_{i:02d}",
                (160, 540, 45),
                (math.sin(a) * 470, 0, math.cos(a) * 470),
                (0, math.degrees(a), 0),
            )
        )
    p += [
        cyl("axle_collar_left", 70, 60, (0, 330, 0)),
        cyl("axle_collar_right", 70, 60, (0, -330, 0)),
    ]
    return s3d.group("wheel", *p)

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def industrial_warehouse_floor_lamp():

    yoke = s3d.at(yoke, on=pan_frame)

        "pan",
        yoke,
        pan_frame,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="+Z",

    )
    shade = shade_part()

        "tilt",
        shade,
        tilt_frame,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Y",
        range=(-0.70 * 180 / math.pi, 0.95 * 180 / math.pi),

def stand_part():

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def weatherproof_searchlight_tower():
    tower = tower_part()
    yoke = yoke_part()
    head = lamp_head_part()
    f = s3d.local(tower, 0, 0, 2750)
    yoke = s3d.at(yoke, on=f)
    s3d.joint("pan", yoke, f, kind="revolute", axis="+Z", range=(-180, 180))
    f2 = s3d.local(yoke, 0, 0, 900)
    head = s3d.at(head, on=f2)
    s3d.joint(
        "tilt",
        head,
        f2,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Y",
        range=(-0.55 * 180 / math.pi, 0.85 * 180 / math.pi),
    )
    return s3d.assembly("weatherproof_searchlight_tower", tower, yoke, head)


def tower_part():
    galvanized = "#9ea8a6"
    stainless = "#d1d6d1"
    concrete = "#7a7870"
    items = []

    def box(name, dims, xyz, mat):
        ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(dims[0], dims[1]), dims[2], both=True)
        items.append(s3d.material(s3d.at(ob, x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2]), mat[0], color=mat[1]))

    def cyl(name, r, l, xyz, mat):
        ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True)
        items.append(s3d.material(s3d.at(ob, x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2]), mat[0], color=mat[1]))

    g = ("steel", galvanized)
    st = ("brushed_steel", stainless)
    co = ("concrete", concrete)
    box("concrete_pad", (1200, 1200, 180), (0, 0, 90), co)
    cyl("base_plate", 390, 45, (0, 0, 197), g)
    cyl("mast_tube", 78, 2500, (0, 0, 1460), g)
    cyl("top_collar", 145, 160, (0, 0, 2620), g)
    cyl("pan_seat", 165, 60, (0, 0, 2720), g)
    cyl("fixed_drip_flange", 205, 24, (0, 0, 2655), g)
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        for sy in (-1, 1):
            corner = ("pos" if sx > 0 else "neg") + "_" + ("pos" if sy > 0 else "neg")
            box("leg_foot_" + corner, (140, 140, 24), (420 * sx, 420 * sy, 185), g)
            add_between(
                "tower_leg_" + corner,
                (420 * sx, 420 * sy, 190),
                (180 * sx, 180 * sy, 2520),
                23,
                g,
                items,
            )
            add_between(
                "cross_brace_" + corner + "_lower",
                (340 * sx, 340 * sy, 460),
                (-180 * sx, 180 * sy, 1420),
                14,
                g,
                items,
            )
            add_between(
                "cross_brace_" + corner + "_upper",
                (200 * sx, 200 * sy, 1420),
                (-160 * sx, 160 * sy, 2320),
                14,
                g,
                items,
            )
    for z, r, n in (
        (440, 470, "lower_tie_ring"),
        (1420, 340, "middle_tie_ring"),
        (2330, 250, "upper_tie_ring"),
    ):
        cyl(n, r, 30, (0, 0, z), g)
    for x in (-270, 270):
        for y in (-270, 270):
            suffix = ("pos" if x > 0 else "neg") + "_" + ("pos" if y > 0 else "neg")
            cyl("anchor_washer_" + suffix, 30, 10, (x, y, 225), st)
            cyl("anchor_stud_" + suffix, 16, 70, (x, y, 247), st)
    return s3d.group("tower", *items)


def add_between(name, p0, p1, r, mat, items):
    dx = p1[0] - p0[0]
    dy = p1[1] - p0[1]
    dz = p1[2] - p0[2]
    length = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
    ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), length, both=True)
    ob = s3d.at(
        ob,
        x=(p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2,
        y=(p0[1] + p1[1]) / 2,
        z=(p0[2] + p1[2]) / 2,
        ry=math.degrees(math.atan2(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), dz)),
        rz=math.degrees(math.atan2(dy, dx)),
    )
    items.append(s3d.material(ob, mat[0], color=mat[1]))


def yoke_part():
    items = []
    g = ("steel", "#9ea8a6")
    st = ("brushed_steel", "#d1d6d1")
    rubber = ("rubber", "#030303")

    def cyl(n, r, l, x, y, z, mat, rx=0):
        ob = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True)
        items.append(s3d.material(s3d.at(ob, x=x, y=y, z=z, rx=rx), mat[0], color=mat[1]))

    def box(n, d, x, y, z, mat):
        ob = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.rect(d[0], d[1]), d[2], both=True)
        items.append(s3d.material(s3d.at(ob, x=x, y=y, z=z), mat[0], color=mat[1]))

    cyl("turntable_bearing", 180, 80, 0, 0, 40, g)
    cyl("rotating_drip_skirt", 245, 36, 0, 0, 115, g)
    cyl("pan_pedestal", 80, 430, 0, 0, 285, g)
    box("yoke_crosshead", (320, 860, 85), 0, 0, 540, g)
    box("yoke_arm_pos", (160, 90, 760), 0, 390, 900, g)
    box("tilt_bearing_pos", (240, 100, 205), 0, 335, 900, g)
    cyl("weather_cap_pos", 105, 26, 0, 451, 900, st, 90)
    cyl("bearing_seal_pos", 70, 20, 0, 287, 900, rubber, 90)
    box("yoke_arm_neg", (160, 90, 760), 0, -390, 900, g)

import sand3d as s3d


def precision_sliding_security_gate():
    frame = fixed_frame()
    leaf = gate_leaf()
    f = s3d.local(frame, 0, 0, 0)
    leaf = s3d.at(leaf, on=f)
    s3d.joint("gate_slide", leaf, f, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 1200))
    rs = []
    for i, x in enumerate((-720, 720)):
        r = roller(i)
        f = s3d.local(leaf, x, 0, 225)
        r = s3d.at(r, on=f)
        s3d.joint(f"roller_spin_{i}", r, f, kind="continuous", axis="+Y")
        rs.append(r)
    bolt = latch_bolt()
    f = s3d.local(leaf, -1230, -90, 1100)
    bolt = s3d.at(bolt, on=f)
    s3d.joint("latch_throw", bolt, f, kind="prismatic", axis="-X", range=(0, 100))
    return s3d.assembly("precision_sliding_security_gate", frame, leaf, *rs, bolt)


def fixed_frame():
    a = []
    G = ("aluminium", "#8c9494")
    D = ("steel", "#0d0e0f")

    R = ("rubber", "#040404")

    W = ("plastic", "#ebeadd")

    def b(n, z, p, m):
        o = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.rect(z[0], z[1]), z[2], both=True)
        o = s3d.at(o, x=p[0], y=p[1], z=p[2])
        s3d.material(o, *m)

    def c(n, r, l, p, m, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
        o = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True)
        o = s3d.at(o, x=p[0], y=p[1], z=p[2], rx=rot[0], ry=rot[1], rz=rot[2])
        s3d.material(o, *m)
        a.append(o)

    b("level_concrete_pad", (5000, 520, 100), (650, 0, 50), C)

    b("rear_channel_lip", (4850, 18, 90), (650, 60, 165), D)
    b("latch_post", (120, 180, 2120), (-1560, 0, 1120), G)

    b("open_stop_pad", (40, 100, 240), (2550, 0, 240), R)
    b("receiver_backplate", (30, 100, 140), (-1515, -65, 1100), B)
    b("receiver_upper_jaw", (160, 100, 20), (-1420, -65, 1145), G)
    b("receiver_lower_jaw", (160, 100, 20), (-1420, -65, 1055), G)
    b("receiver_mouth_datum", (12, 110, 110), (-1340, -65, 1100), Y)

            c(f"{side}_guide_roller_{i}", 25, 280, (x, y, 1780), R)
            b(f"{side}_guide_bracket_{i}", (45, 40, 200), (x, y, 1985), G)
            c(
                f"{side}_guide_adjuster_{i}",
                12,
                16,
                (x, y + (-22 if y < 0 else 22), 1965),

                (90, 0, 0),
            )
    for i, x in enumerate([-1100, -700, -300, 100, 500, 900, 1300, 1700, 2100, 2500]):
        b(f"track_index_{i}", (10, 140 if i % 2 == 0 else 90, 6), (x, -195, 101), W)

def roller(i):

import sand3d as s3d


def curbside_mailbox():
    post = post_assembly()
    bf = s3d.local(post, 340, 0, 1080)
    body = s3d.at(mailbox_body(), on=bf)
    s3d.group("post_with_body", post, body)
    df = s3d.local(body, -6, 0, 6)
    door = s3d.at(front_door(), on=df)
    s3d.joint("body_to_door", door, df, kind="revolute", axis="-Y", range=(0, 110))
    ff = s3d.local(body, 140, 110, 135)
    flag = s3d.at(signal_flag(), on=ff)
    s3d.joint("body_to_flag", flag, ff, kind="revolute", axis="-Y", range=(0, 95))
    return s3d.assembly("curbside_mailbox", post, body, door, flag)


def arched(w, h, bottom=0):
    a = w / 2
    return [
        (-a, bottom),
        (a, bottom),
        (a, h),
        (a * 0.966, h + a * 0.259),
        (a * 0.866, h + a * 0.5),
        (a * 0.707, h + a * 0.707),
        (a * 0.5, h + a * 0.866),
        (a * 0.259, h + a * 0.966),
        (0, h + a),
        (-a * 0.259, h + a * 0.966),
        (-a * 0.5, h + a * 0.866),
        (-a * 0.707, h + a * 0.707),
        (-a * 0.866, h + a * 0.5),
        (-a * 0.966, h + a * 0.259),
        (-a, h),
    ]


def post_assembly():
    c = "#63472e"
    p = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("post", s3d.rect(100, 100), 1150, both=True), z=575), "oak", color=c
    )
    a = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("arm", s3d.rect(360, 80), 50, both=True), x=180, z=940), "oak", color=c
    )
    r = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rear_support", s3d.rect(160, 180), 280, both=True), x=440, z=940),
        "oak",
        color=c,
    )
    return s3d.group("post_assembly", p, a, r)


def mailbox_body():
    outer = arched(220, 150)
    inner = arched(196, 150, 12)
    # Rotation maps extrusion to X, profile width to Y, height to Z.
    shell = s3d.extrude("shell", s3d.poly(outer) - s3d.poly(inner), 520, both=True)
    shell = s3d.material(s3d.transform(shell, rx=90, rz=90, x=260), "aluminium", color="#b8bdc4")
    cap = s3d.extrude("rear_cap", s3d.poly(outer), 12, both=True)
    cap = s3d.material(s3d.transform(cap, rx=90, rz=90, x=514), "aluminium", color="#b8bdc4")
    return s3d.group("mailbox_body", shell, cap)


def front_door():
    p = s3d.extrude("door_panel", s3d.poly(arched(210, 145)), 10, both=True)
    p = s3d.material(s3d.transform(p, rx=90, rz=90, x=1, z=-6), "aluminium", color="#b8bdc4")
    h = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("door_hinge", s3d.circle(12), 192, both=True), rx=90),
        "steel",
        color="#2e3338",
    )
    u = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("door_handle", s3d.circle(14), 16, both=True), x=-8, z=102, ry=90),
        "steel",
        color="#2e3338",
    )
    return s3d.group("front_door", p, h, u)


def signal_flag():
    h = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("flag_hub", s3d.circle(16), 16, both=True), y=8, rx=90),
        "steel",
        color="#2e3338",
    )
    b = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("flag_bar", s3d.rect(110, 4), 12, both=True), x=55, y=14),
        "painted_metal",
        color="#d11a1a",
    )
    p = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("flag_plate", s3d.rect(55, 4), 90, both=True), x=135, y=14, z=45),
        "painted_metal",
        color="#d11a1a",
    )
    return s3d.group("signal_flag", h, b, p)

import sand3d as s3d

    s3d.joint(
        "post_slide", post, s3d.local(sleeve, 0, 0, 0), kind="prismatic", axis="-Z", range=(0, 950)
    )
    flap = s3d.at(flap_part(), on=s3d.local(sleeve, 180, 0, 10))
    s3d.joint(
        "sleeve_flap_hinge",
        flap,
        s3d.local(sleeve, 180, 0, 10),
        kind="revolute",
        axis="+Y",
        range=(-87.66, 0),
    )
    cover = s3d.at(light_part(), on=s3d.local(post, 0, -28, 938))

        cover,
        s3d.local(post, 0, -28, 938),
        kind="revolute",

    bb = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("flap_barrel_b", s3d.circle(22), 26), x=180, y=space - 13, z=10, rx=90)
    return s3d.group(
        "sleeve",
        s3d.material(s3d.join(flange, tube, ledge, ea, eb, ba, bb), "steel", color="#94999e"),

def post_part():

import sand3d as s3d


def louvered_shutter():
    frame = frame_part()
    slats = []
    for i in range(12):
        f = s3d.local(frame, 0, 0, 70 + i * 60)
        slat = s3d.at(slat_part(), on=f)
        s3d.joint(f"slat_{i}_pivot", slat, f, kind="revolute", axis="+X", range=(-57.2958, 57.2958))
        slats.append(slat)
    return s3d.assembly("louvered_shutter", frame, *slats)


def frame_part(width=320, depth=40, height=800, stile_width=40):
    left = s3d.at(
        s3d.extrude("left_stile", s3d.rect(stile_width, depth), height, both=True), x=-180, z=400
    )
    right = s3d.at(
        s3d.extrude("right_stile", s3d.rect(stile_width, depth), height, both=True), x=180, z=400
    )
    top = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("top_rail", s3d.rect(width, depth), 40, both=True), z=780)
    bottom = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("bottom_rail", s3d.rect(width, depth), 40, both=True), z=20)
    frame = s3d.group("frame", left, right, top, bottom)
    s3d.material(frame, "steel", color="#454545")
    return frame


def slat_part(length=316, width=55, thickness=5, pin_radius=3, pin_length=10):
    blade = s3d.extrude("blade", s3d.rect(length, width), thickness, both=True)
    left_pin = s3d.at(
        s3d.extrude("left_pin", s3d.circle(2 * pin_radius), pin_length, both=True), x=-160, ry=90
    )
    right_pin = s3d.at(
        s3d.extrude("right_pin", s3d.circle(2 * pin_radius), pin_length, both=True), x=160, ry=90
    )
    slat = s3d.group("slat", blade, left_pin, right_pin)
    s3d.material(slat, "steel", color="#555555")
    return slat

def hydraulic_freight_elevator():

    door_frame = s3d.local(shaft, 0, 640, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    door = s3d.at(landing_door_part(), on=door_frame)

    box("right_hoistway_wall", (80, 1480, 3200), (970, -190, 1600), "steel", frame)
    box("landing_header", (1540, 100, 200), (0, 730, 1840), "steel", frame)

    box("right_jamb", (100, 100, 1780), (720, 730, 890), "steel", frame)
    box("door_track", (2490, 80, 60), (745, 640, 1750), "steel", frame)
    box("door_pocket_backer", (1340, 40, 1720), (1320, 560, 860), "plastic", panel)
    box("pocket_end_post", (100, 100, 1780), (2040, 730, 890), "steel", frame)
    box("door_stop", (20, 60, 1700), (-660, 660, 850), "rubber", yellow)
    box("left_guide_rail", (40, 180, 2900), (-910, -30, 1450), "steel", guide)

    pend = s3d.at(pendulum(), on=qf)

    wf = s3d.local(pend, 0, -13, -105)
    weight = s3d.at(sliding_weight(), on=wf)

def box(name, dims, pos, kind, color):

def sphere(name, r, pos, kind="brass", color="#f2b348"):

    a += [

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def travel_folding_headphones():
    band = headband()
    ls = slider()
    rs = slider()
    ly = yoke()
    ry = yoke()
    lc = cup()
    rc = cup()
    f = s3d.local(band, 0, -130, 175)
    ls = s3d.at(ls, on=f)
    s3d.joint("left_size_slide", ls, f, kind="prismatic", axis="-Z", range=(0, 40))
    f = s3d.local(band, 0, 130, 175)
    rs = s3d.at(rs, on=f)
    s3d.joint("right_size_slide", rs, f, kind="prismatic", axis="-Z", range=(0, 40))
    f = s3d.local(ls, 0, 0, -95)
    ly = s3d.at(ly, on=f)
    s3d.joint("left_fold_hinge", ly, f, kind="revolute", axis="+X", range=(0, 92.82))
    f = s3d.local(rs, 0, 0, -95)
    ry = s3d.at(ry, on=f)
    s3d.joint("right_fold_hinge", ry, f, kind="revolute", axis="-X", range=(0, 92.82))
    f = s3d.local(ly, 0, 0, -130)
    lc = s3d.at(lc, on=f)
    s3d.joint("left_cup_swivel", lc, f, kind="revolute", axis="+Z", range=(-48.70, 48.70))
    f = s3d.local(ry, 0, 0, -130)
    rc = s3d.at(rc, on=f)
    s3d.joint("right_cup_swivel", rc, f, kind="revolute", axis="+Z", range=(-48.70, 48.70))
    return s3d.assembly("travel_folding_headphones", band, ls, rs, ly, ry, lc, rc)


def headband():
    a = s3d.wire(
        "headband_outer",
        s3d.spline(
            [
                (0, -130, 205),
                (0, -116, 272),
                (0, -60, 323),
                (0, 0, 340),
                (0, 60, 323),
                (0, 116, 272),
                (0, 130, 205),
            ]
        ),
        18,
    )
    s3d.material(a, "plastic", color="#040405")
    b = s3d.wire(
        "headband_cushion",
        s3d.spline([(0, -104, 205), (0, -70, 278), (0, 0, 306), (0, 70, 278), (0, 104, 205)]),
        21,
    )
    s3d.material(b, "rubber", color="#050506")
    parts = [a, b]
    for side, y in (("left", -130), ("right", 130)):
        for name, x, z, w, d, h in (
            ("front", -18, 178, 8, 32, 106),
            ("rear", 18, 178, 8, 32, 106),
            ("bridge", 0, 232, 44, 33, 24),
        ):
            a = s3d.at(
                s3d.extrude(side + "_sleeve_" + name, s3d.rect(w, d), h, both=True), x=x, y=y, z=z
            )
            s3d.material(a, "plastic", color="#050506")
            parts.append(a)
    return s3d.group("headband", *parts)


def slider():
    parts = []
    for name, w, d, h, z, kind, col in [
        ("slider_blade", 28, 12, 120, -35, "aluminium", "#8f9499"),
        ("hinge_lug", 17, 14, 26, -84, "painted_metal", "#080809"),
    ]:
        a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(w, d), h, both=True), z=z)
        s3d.material(a, kind, color=col)
        parts.append(a)
    for name, r, l, z, kind, col in [
        ("fold_barrel", 10, 16, -95, "painted_metal", "#080809"),
        ("fold_pin", 5.5, 60, -95, "aluminium", "#8f9499"),
    ]:
        a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True), z=z, ry=90)
        s3d.material(a, kind, color=col)
        parts.append(a)
    return s3d.group("slider", *parts)


def yoke():
    a = s3d.wire(
        "yoke_fork",
        s3d.spline(
            [
                (-52, 0, -130),
                (-52, 0, -84),
                (-34, 0, -32),
                (0, 0, -20),
                (34, 0, -32),
                (52, 0, -84),
                (52, 0, -130),
            ]
        ),
        9.6,
    )
    s3d.material(a, "aluminium", color="#8f9499")
    parts = [a]
    for name, w, d, h, x, z in [
        ("hinge_neck", 18, 14, 26, 0, -26),
        ("socket_web_0", 6, 8, 28, -14, -34),
        ("socket_web_1", 6, 8, 28, 14, -34),
        ("hinge_bridge", 52, 12, 10, 0, -20),
        ("outer_web", 10, 12, 20, -19, -16),
        ("inner_web", 10, 12, 20, 19, -16),
    ]:
        a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(w, d), h, both=True), x=x, z=z)
        s3d.material(a, "painted_metal", color="#080809")
        parts.append(a)
    for name, r, l, x, z, turn in [
        ("swivel_socket", 12, 14, 0, -55, 0),
        ("outer_knuckle", 10.5, 12, -19, 0, 90),
        ("inner_knuckle", 10.5, 12, 19, 0, 90),
        ("front_pivot", 7, 12, -52, -130, 90),
        ("rear_pivot", 7, 12, 52, -130, 90),
    ]:
        a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True), x=x, z=z, ry=turn)
        s3d.material(a, "painted_metal", color="#080809")
        parts.append(a)
    return s3d.group("yoke", *parts)


def cup():
    parts = []
    a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("cup_shell", s3d.ellipse(90, 126), 62, both=True), rx=90)
    s3d.material(a, "plastic", color="#0e0f10")
    parts.append(a)
    for y, label in ((34, "inner_pad"), (-34, "outer_pad")):
        a = s3d.extrude(label, s3d.ellipse(77, 108), 17, both=True)
        a = s3d.cut(a, s3d.extrude("pad_opening", s3d.ellipse(60, 91), 20, both=True))
        a = s3d.at(a, y=y, rx=90)
        s3d.material(a, "rubber", color="#050506")
        parts.append(a)
        a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(label + "_cloth", s3d.ellipse(61, 88), 2.2, both=True), y=y, rx=90)
        s3d.material(a, "fabric", color="#030304")
        parts.append(a)
    for name, x, z, r, l, turn, kind, col in [
        ("front_boss", -38, 0, 7.5, 18, 90, "painted_metal", "#080809"),
        ("rear_boss", 38, 0, 7.5, 18, 90, "painted_metal", "#080809"),
        ("swivel_post", 0, 75, 7, 26, 0, "aluminium", "#8f9499"),
    ]:
        a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True), x=x, z=z, ry=turn)
        s3d.material(a, kind, color=col)
        parts.append(a)
    return s3d.group("cup", *parts)

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def wall_thermostat():
    body = thermostat_body()
    frame = s3d.local(body, 0, 0, 12)
    dial = s3d.at(dial_part(), on=frame)
    s3d.joint("body_to_dial", dial, frame, kind="continuous", axis="+Z")
    return s3d.assembly("wall_thermostat", body, dial)


def thermostat_body():
    plate = s3d.extrude("wall_plate", s3d.rect(148, 148, r=18), 4, both=True)
    s3d.material(plate, "plastic", color="#f0f0ed")
    pedestal = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rear_pedestal", s3d.circle(112), 4, both=True), z=6)
    s3d.material(pedestal, "plastic", color="#f5f3ed")
    shoulder = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("bearing_shoulder", s3d.circle(90), 4, both=True), z=10)
    s3d.material(shoulder, "plastic", color="#f5f3ed")
    core = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("center_core", s3d.circle(56), 12, both=True), z=18)
    s3d.material(core, "plastic", color="#f5f3ed")
    lens = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("display_lens", s3d.rect(24, 7), 1.6, both=True), z=24.8)
    s3d.material(lens, "glass", color="#14191f", opacity=0.85)
    mark = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("top_index_mark", s3d.rect(10, 4), 3, both=True), y=44, z=13.5)
    s3d.material(mark, "plastic", color="#2e2e2e")
    return s3d.group("thermostat_body", plate, pedestal, shoulder, core, lens, mark)


def dial_part():
    collar = s3d.revolve("dial_collar", [(60, 0), (60, 10), (58, 16), (39, 16), (37, 10), (36, 0)])
    s3d.material(collar, "plastic", color="#3b3d42")
    bezel = s3d.revolve("dial_bezel", [(63, 0), (62, 4), (59, 8), (38, 8), (36, 4), (36, 0)])
    bezel = s3d.at(bezel, z=14)
    s3d.material(bezel, "aluminium", color="#b3b8bf")
    ribs = []
    for i in range(18):
        a = 2 * math.pi * i / 18
        rib = s3d.extrude(f"grip_rib_{i:02d}", s3d.rect(3.5, 6), 10, both=True)
        rib = s3d.at(rib, x=61.5 * math.cos(a), y=61.5 * math.sin(a), z=14, rz=math.degrees(a))
        s3d.material(rib, "plastic", color="#3b3d42")
        ribs.append(rib)
    return s3d.group("dial", collar, bezel, *ribs)

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d


def combination_padlock():
    body = body_part()
    shackle_frame = s3d.local(body, -12, 0, 60)
    shackle = s3d.at(shackle_part(), on=shackle_frame)
    s3d.joint(
        "body_to_shackle", shackle, shackle_frame, kind="revolute", axis="-Y", range=(0, 91.67)
    )
    children = [body, shackle]
    for index, center_x in enumerate((-12, -4, 4, 12), start=1):
        frame = s3d.local(body, center_x, 19, 30)
        dial = s3d.at(dial_part(), on=frame)
        s3d.joint(f"body_to_dial_{index}", dial, frame, kind="continuous", axis="-X")
        children.append(dial)
    return s3d.assembly("combination_padlock", *children)


def body_part(width=46, depth=23, lower_height=50, cap_height=10):
    shell = s3d.extrude("body_shell", s3d.rect(width, lower_height, r=5.5), depth, both=True)
    shell = s3d.at(shell, rx=90, z=lower_height / 2)
    shell = s3d.material(shell, "painted_metal", color="#2e3036")
    top_z = lower_height + cap_height / 2
    visuals = [
        shell,
        _box("top_front_strip", 46, 7.4, 10, 0, 7.8, top_z, "#2e3036"),
        _box("top_back_strip", 46, 7.4, 10, 0, -7.8, top_z, "#2e3036"),
        _box("top_left_block", 6.2, 9.2, 10, -19.9, 0, top_z, "#2e3036"),
        _box("top_center_block", 25.4, 9.2, 10, 0, 0, top_z, "#2e3036"),
        _box("top_right_block", 6.2, 9.2, 10, 19.9, 0, top_z, "#2e3036"),
        _box("retained_leg_keeper", 0.6, 5.2, 10, -14.7, 0, top_z, "#2e3036"),
        _box("dial_panel", 39, 2.2, 20, 0, 12.4, 30, "#47494f"),
        _box("upper_face_lip", 41, 3, 4, 0, 12.7, 41, "#47494f"),
        _box("lower_face_lip", 41, 3, 4, 0, 12.7, 19, "#47494f"),
    ]
    return s3d.group("body", *visuals)


def _box(name, sx, sy, sz, x, y, z, color):
    ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(sx, sy), sz, both=True)
    ob = s3d.at(ob, x=x, y=y, z=z)
    return s3d.material(ob, "painted_metal", color=color)


def shackle_part(span=24, crown_height=30, rod_radius=2.4, retained_drop=6, free_drop=-4.5):
    path = s3d.spline(
        [
            (0, 0, -retained_drop),
            (0, 0, 20),
            (1, 0, 27),
            (4, 0, crown_height),
            (span - 4, 0, crown_height),
            (span - 1, 0, 27),
            (span, 0, 20),
            (span, 0, free_drop),
        ],
        tangents=((0, 0, 1), (0, 0, -1)),
    )
    bar = s3d.wire("shackle_bar", path, 2 * rod_radius)
    bar = s3d.material(bar, "steel", color="#dce0e6")
    tip = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("free_leg_tip", 2.4), x=span, z=free_drop - 1.2)
    tip = s3d.material(tip, "steel", color="#dce0e6")
    return s3d.group("shackle", bar, tip)


def dial_part(radius=5.5, length=6.8):
    wheel = s3d.extrude("dial_wheel", s3d.circle(2 * radius), length, both=True)
    wheel = s3d.at(wheel, ry=90)
    wheel = s3d.material(wheel, "rubber", color="#1a1c1f")

import sand3d as s3d


def extension_slide():
    outer = s3d.at(outer_rail(), x=0, y=0, z=0)
    f = s3d.local(outer, 100, 0, 22)
    mid = s3d.at(intermediate_rail(), on=f)
    s3d.joint("outer_to_intermediate", mid, f, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 120))
    g = s3d.local(mid, 80, 0, 14)
    car = s3d.at(terminal_carriage(), on=g)
    s3d.joint("intermediate_to_carriage", car, g, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 80))
    return s3d.assembly("extension_slide", outer, mid, car)


def outer_rail(length=340, width=55, height=22, wall=3, base=3.5):
    shell = s3d.join(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("base", s3d.rect(length, width), base, both=True), z=base / 2),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("wall", s3d.rect(length, wall), height - base, both=True),
            y=(width - wall) / 2,
            z=(height + base) / 2,
        ),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("wall2", s3d.rect(length, wall), height - base, both=True),
            y=-(width - wall) / 2,
            z=(height + base) / 2,
        ),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("runner", s3d.rect(length, 4), 1.5, both=True),
            y=width / 2 - wall - 2,
            z=height - 0.75,
        ),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("runner2", s3d.rect(length, 4), 1.5, both=True),
            y=-(width / 2 - wall - 2),
            z=height - 0.75,
        ),
    )
    shell = s3d.at(shell, x=length / 2)
    for x in (55, 285):
        s3d.hole(shell, 6.4, on=(x, 0), depth=base + 0.1)
    s3d.pocket(shell, s3d.slot(40, 7), depth=base + 0.1, on=s3d.local(shell, 170, 0, base))
    return s3d.group("outer_rail", s3d.material(shell, "steel", color="#b8bdc4"))


def intermediate_rail(length=240, width=43, height=14, wall=2.5, base=3):
    shell = s3d.join(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("midbase", s3d.rect(length, width), base, both=True), z=base / 2),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("midwall", s3d.rect(length, wall), height - base, both=True),
            y=(width - wall) / 2,
            z=(height + base) / 2,
        ),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("midwall2", s3d.rect(length, wall), height - base, both=True),
            y=-(width - wall) / 2,
            z=(height + base) / 2,
        ),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("midrunner", s3d.rect(length, 3.5), 1.2, both=True),
            y=width / 2 - wall - 1.75,
            z=height - 0.6,
        ),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("midrunner2", s3d.rect(length, 3.5), 1.2, both=True),
            y=-(width / 2 - wall - 1.75),
            z=height - 0.6,
        ),
    )
    shell = s3d.at(shell, x=length / 2)
    for x in (50, 190):
        s3d.hole(shell, 6.4, on=(x, 0), depth=base + 0.1)
    s3d.pocket(shell, s3d.slot(32, 6), depth=base + 0.1, on=s3d.local(shell, 120, 0, base))
    return s3d.group("intermediate_rail", s3d.material(shell, "steel", color="#6e737a"))


def terminal_carriage(length=160, shoe_width=31, plate_width=38, shoe_height=9, plate_thickness=4):
    body = s3d.join(
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("shoe", s3d.rect(length, shoe_width), shoe_height, both=True),
            z=shoe_height / 2,
        ),
        s3d.at(
            s3d.extrude("plate", s3d.rect(length, plate_width), plate_thickness, both=True),
            z=shoe_height + plate_thickness / 2,
        ),
    )
    body = s3d.at(body, x=length / 2)
    for x in (40, length - 40):
        s3d.hole(body, 6, on=(x, 0), depth=plate_thickness + 0.1)
    return s3d.group("terminal_carriage", s3d.material(body, "steel", color="#2b2e33"))

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def floor_task_lamp():
    base = base_part()
    lower = lower_arm()
    f1 = s3d.local(base, 0, 0, 97, 0, -math.degrees(1.10), 0)
    lower = s3d.at(lower, on=f1)
    s3d.joint(
        "base_to_lower_arm",
        lower,
        f1,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Y",
        range=(-math.degrees(1.10), math.degrees(0.55)),
    )
    upper = upper_arm()
    f2 = s3d.local(lower, 700, 0, 0, 0, math.degrees(0.65), 0)
    upper = s3d.at(upper, on=f2)
    s3d.joint(
        "lower_arm_to_upper_arm",
        upper,
        f2,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Y",
        range=(-math.degrees(1), math.degrees(1)),

    shade = shade_part()

        shade,
        f3,

def lower_arm():

    s3d.material(e, "plastic", color="#33363b")
    return s3d.group("lower_arm", a, b, c, d, e)


def upper_arm():
    a = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("elbow_barrel", s3d.circle(15), 24, both=True), rx=-90)
    s3d.material(a, "steel", color="#abaeb8")
    b = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("elbow_web", s3d.rect(75, 14), 14, both=True), x=37.5)
    s3d.material(b, "plastic", color="#33363b")
    c = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("upper_tube", s3d.circle(18), 260, both=True), x=200, ry=90)
    s3d.material(c, "plastic", color="#33363b")
    d = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("yoke_bridge", s3d.rect(56, 104), 12, both=True), x=358, z=-38)
    s3d.material(d, "plastic", color="#33363b")

    s3d.material(e, "plastic", color="#33363b")
    f = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("yoke_arm_0", s3d.rect(60, 8), 70, both=True), x=402, y=-45, z=-5)
    s3d.material(f, "plastic", color="#33363b")
    g = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("yoke_arm_1", s3d.rect(60, 8), 70, both=True), x=402, y=45, z=-5)
    s3d.material(g, "plastic", color="#33363b")
    return s3d.group("upper_arm", a, b, c, d, e, f, g)


def shade_part():
    body = s3d.at(s3d.revolve("shade_body", [(0, -60), (28, -60), (57, 130), (0, 130)]), ry=90)

            f = s3d.local(housing, x, y, 26)

import sand3d as s3d


def nas_storage_tower_chassis():
    chassis = _chassis()
    door_frame = s3d.local(chassis, -151, -305, 450)
    door = s3d.at(_door(), on=door_frame)
    s3d.joint(
        "chassis_to_door",
        door,
        door_frame,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Z",
        range=(0, 1.75 * 180 / 3.14),
    )
    trays = []
    for i, z in enumerate((210, 338, 466, 594, 722)):
        f = s3d.local(chassis, 0, -287, z)
        child = s3d.at(_tray(i), on=f)
        s3d.joint(f"chassis_to_tray_{i}", child, f, kind="prismatic", axis="-Y", range=(0, 220))
        trays.append(child)
    return s3d.assembly("nas_storage_tower_chassis", chassis, door, *trays)


def _chassis():
    dark = "#0e0f10"
    black = "#030304"
    steel = "#8c9499"
    parts = []

    def box(name, size, pos, color, kind="steel"):
        ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
        ob = s3d.at(ob, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2])
        s3d.material(ob, kind, color=color)
        return ob

    parts += [
        box("side_wall_0", (18, 550, 900), (-141, 0, 450), dark),
        box("side_wall_1", (18, 550, 900), (141, 0, 450), dark),
        box("top_wall", (300, 550, 26), (0, 0, 887), dark),
        box("bottom_wall", (300, 550, 26), (0, 0, 13), dark),
        box("rear_wall", (300, 26, 900), (0, 262, 450), dark),
    ]
    parts += [
        box("front_sill", (300, 20, 60), (0, -265, 95), black, "plastic"),
        box("front_header", (300, 20, 60), (0, -265, 815), black, "plastic"),
        box("front_post_0", (20, 25, 760), (-140, -264, 455), black, "plastic"),
        box("front_post_1", (20, 25, 760), (140, -264, 455), black, "plastic"),
    ]
    for i, z in enumerate((210, 338, 466, 594, 722)):
        parts.append(box(f"guide_{i}_0", (12, 420, 14), (-126, -45, z - 66), "#8c9499"))
        parts.append(box(f"guide_{i}_1", (12, 420, 14), (126, -45, z - 66), "#8c9499"))
        if i < 4:
            parts.append(
                box(f"bay_divider_{i}", (270, 18, 10), (0, -264, z + 64), black, "plastic")
            )
    for i, z in enumerate((245, 285, 325, 365, 405, 445, 485, 525, 565, 605)):
        parts.append(box(f"side_vent_{i}", (4, 112, 10), (151, 35, z), black, "plastic"))
    for i, z in enumerate((705, 735, 765)):
        parts.append(
            box(
                f"status_light_{i}",
                (12, 5, 12),
                (139, -279, z),
                "#1973ff" if i != 1 else "#ff9419",
                "plastic",
            )
        )
    parts.append(box("status_strip", (18, 7, 100), (139, -275, 735), black, "plastic"))

    def cyl(name, r, l, pos):

import sand3d as s3d


def boxed_folding_arm():
    base = base_plate()
    f1 = s3d.local(base, 0, 0, 20)
    link1 = s3d.at(link_1(), on=f1)
    s3d.joint("base_to_link_1", link1, f1, kind="revolute", axis="+Z", range=(-180, 180))
    f2 = s3d.local(link1, 300, 0, 40)
    link2 = s3d.at(link_2(), on=f2)
    s3d.joint("link_1_to_2", link2, f2, kind="revolute", axis="+Z", range=(-180, 180))
    f3 = s3d.local(link2, 300, 0, 40)
    link3 = s3d.at(link_3(), on=f3)
    s3d.joint("link_2_to_3", link3, f3, kind="revolute", axis="+Z", range=(-180, 180))
    return s3d.assembly("boxed_folding_arm", base, link1, link2, link3)


def base_plate(w=200, d=200, t=20):
    visual = s3d.extrude("base_visual", s3d.rect(w, d), t, both=True)
    visual = s3d.at(visual, z=t / 2)
    part = s3d.group("base_plate", visual)
    s3d.material(part, "plastic", color="#808080")
    return part


def link_1(l=300, w=60, h=40):
    visual = s3d.extrude("link_1_visual", s3d.rect(l, w), h, both=True)
    visual = s3d.at(visual, x=l / 2, z=h / 2)
    part = s3d.group("link_1", visual)
    s3d.material(part, "plastic", color="#808080")
    return part


def link_2(l=300, w=60, h=40):
    visual = s3d.extrude("link_2_visual", s3d.rect(l, w), h, both=True)
    visual = s3d.at(visual, x=l / 2, z=h / 2)
    part = s3d.group("link_2", visual)
    s3d.material(part, "plastic", color="#808080")
    return part


def link_3(l=300, w=40, h=20, tab_l=50):
    main = s3d.extrude("link_3_visual", s3d.rect(l, w), h, both=True)
    main = s3d.at(main, x=l / 2, z=h / 2)
    tab = s3d.extrude("end_tab", s3d.rect(tab_l, w), h, both=True)
    tab = s3d.at(tab, x=l + tab_l / 2, z=h / 2)
    part = s3d.group("link_3", main, tab)
    s3d.material(part, "plastic", color="#808080")
    return part

import sand3d as s3d


def contemporary_metal_ceiling_fan():
    canopy = canopy_part()
    downrod = downrod_part()
    f1 = s3d.local(canopy, 0, 0, 0, 0, 162, 0)
    downrod = s3d.at(downrod, on=f1)
    f2 = s3d.local(downrod, 0, 0, 680, 0, 0, 0)
    motor = s3d.at(motor_housing(), on=f2)
    f3 = s3d.local(motor, 0, 0, 160, 0, 0, 0)
    rotor = s3d.at(blade_assembly(), on=f3)
    s3d.joint("motor_to_blade_assembly", rotor, f3, kind="continuous", axis="normal")
    return s3d.assembly(
        "contemporary_metal_ceiling_fan", s3d.group("fixed_fan", canopy, downrod, motor), rotor
    )


def canopy_part():
    cup = s3d.revolve("canopy_cup", [(75, -6), (175, 30), (190, 95), (145, 155), (45, 190)])
    plate = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("ceiling_plate", s3d.circle(400), 12, both=True), z=196)
    ring = s3d.at(s3d.torus("socket_ring", 130, 20), z=-10)
    pad = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("socket_pad", s3d.rect(31, 30), 30, both=True), x=67)
    for ob, kind, color in [
        (cup, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (plate, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (ring, "steel", "#141616"),
        (pad, "steel", "#141616"),
    ]:
        s3d.material(ob, kind, color=color)
    return s3d.group("canopy", cup, plate, ring, pad)


def downrod_part():
    ball = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("swivel_ball", 104), z=-52)
    rod = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rod_tube", s3d.circle(42), 470, both=True), z=265)
    upper = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("upper_collar", s3d.circle(72), 40, both=True), z=56)
    lower = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("lower_collar", s3d.circle(80), 55, both=True), z=507.5)
    for ob, kind, color in [
        (ball, "plastic", "#4d4f4f"),
        (rod, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (upper, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (lower, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
    ]:
        s3d.material(ob, kind, color=color)
    return s3d.group("downrod", ball, rod, upper, lower)


def motor_housing():
    shell = s3d.revolve(
        "motor_shell",
        [
            (0, -105),
            (70, -105),
            (125, -93),
            (166, -62),
            (181, -23),
            (181, 23),
            (166, 62),
            (125, 93),
            (70, 105),
            (0, 105),
        ],
    )
    top = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("top_collar", s3d.circle(104), 40, both=True), z=-125)
    cap = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("lower_bearing_cap", s3d.circle(196), 32, both=True), z=121)
    band = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("motor_band", s3d.circle(368), 8, both=True), z=64)
    for ob, kind, color in [
        (shell, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (top, "brushed_steel", "#9ea3a1"),
        (cap, "plastic", "#4d4f4f"),
        (band, "plastic", "#4d4f4f"),
    ]:
        s3d.material(ob, kind, color=color)
    return s3d.group("motor_housing", shell, top, cap, band)


def blade_assembly():
    hub = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rotor_hub", s3d.circle(244), 46, both=True), z=-23)
    dome = s3d.at(s3d.sphere("spinner_dome", 176), z=-68)
    s3d.material(hub, "plastic", color="#4d4f4f")
    s3d.material(dome, "brushed_steel", color="#9ea3a1")
    blades = []
    # Swept planform samples approximate the source's centerline and chord across radius.
    outline = [
        (105, -59),
        (170, -49),
        (250, -43),
        (340, -34),
        (430, -17),
        (530, 8),
        (640, 60),
        (750, 156),
        (795, 213),
        (790, 317),
        (740, 322),
        (640, 257),
        (530, 142),
        (430, 105),
        (340, 76),
        (250, 62),
        (170, 67),
        (105, 59),
    ]
    for i in range(4):
        blade = s3d.at(s3d.extrude(f"blade_{i}", s3d.poly(outline), 8, both=True), rz=i * 90, z=14)
        s3d.material(blade, "aluminium", color="#bdc2bf")
        blades.append(blade)
    return s3d.group("blade_assembly", hub, dome, *blades)

import sand3d as s3d


def revolving_door():
    base = base_part()
    rotor = rotor_part()
    f = s3d.local(base, 0, 0, 0)
    rotor = s3d.at(rotor, on=f)
    s3d.joint("rotor_spin", rotor, f, kind="continuous", axis="+Z")
    return s3d.assembly("revolving_door", base, rotor)


def base_part(radius=900, wall_outer=850, wall_inner=810, height=2200):
    floor_plate = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("floor_plate", s3d.circle(2 * radius), 20, both=True), z=10)
    central_post = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("central_post", s3d.circle(50), 2180, both=True), z=1110)
    bottom_collar = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("bottom_collar", s3d.circle(80), 30, both=True), z=35)
    canopy = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("canopy", s3d.circle(2 * radius), 100, both=True), z=2250)
    walls = s3d.extrude(
        "enclosure_walls", s3d.circle(2 * wall_outer) - s3d.circle(2 * wall_inner), height
    )
    tri1 = s3d.extrude("door_cut_a", s3d.poly([(0, 0), (600, 1200), (-600, 1200)]), 2500)
    tri2 = s3d.extrude("door_cut_b", s3d.poly([(0, 0), (600, -1200), (-600, -1200)]), 2500)
    walls = s3d.cut(walls, tri1, tri2)
    walls = s3d.at(walls, z=30)
    for ob in (floor_plate, central_post, bottom_collar, canopy, walls):
        s3d.material(ob, "steel", color="#777777")
    return s3d.group("base", floor_plate, central_post, bottom_collar, canopy, walls)


def rotor_part(height=2100, outer_radius=40, inner_radius=26):
    hub = s3d.extrude("hub", s3d.circle(2 * outer_radius) - s3d.circle(2 * inner_radius), height)
    blade_profile = s3d.rect(
        760,
        20,
    )
    blade1 = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("blade1", blade_profile, height), x=420)
    blade2 = s3d.at(
        s3d.extrude("blade2", blade_profile, height, on=s3d.Frame().turn(rz=120)), x=420
    )
    blade3 = s3d.at(
        s3d.extrude("blade3", blade_profile, height, on=s3d.Frame().turn(rz=240)), x=420
    )
    rotor = s3d.join(hub, blade1, blade2, blade3)
    rotor = s3d.at(rotor, z=50)
    s3d.material(rotor, "steel", color="#777777")
    return s3d.group("rotor", rotor)

def microscope_xy_translation_table():

    )
    panel_frame = s3d.local(body, 168, -181, 154)

    for i, dz in enumerate((48, 0, -48), 1):
        f = s3d.local(panel, 0, -3, dz)

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def industrial_sliding_security_gate():
    frame = fixed_frame()
    leaf = s3d.at(gate_leaf(), on=s3d.local(frame, 180, 0, 290))
    s3d.joint(
        "frame_to_gate",
        leaf,
        s3d.local(frame, 180, 0, 290),
        kind="prismatic",
        axis="+X",
        range=(0, 1540),
    )
    return s3d.assembly("industrial_sliding_security_gate", frame, leaf)


def _box(name, size, xyz, material, rpy=(0, 0, 0)):
    ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
    s3d.at(ob, x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2], rx=rpy[0], ry=rpy[1], rz=rpy[2])
    s3d.material(ob, "steel", color=material)
    return ob


def _cyl(name, r, l, xyz, material, along_y=False):
    ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True)
    if along_y:

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def built_in_gas_grill():
    body = grill_body()
    f = s3d.local(body, x=30, z=370)
    hood = s3d.at(hood_part(), on=f)
    s3d.joint("body_to_hood", hood, f, kind="revolute", axis="-Y", range=(0, 95))
    f = s3d.local(body, x=105, z=292)
    rack = s3d.at(warming_rack(), on=f)
    s3d.joint("body_to_warming_rack", rack, f, kind="revolute", axis="-Y", range=(0, 75))
    return s3d.assembly("built_in_gas_grill", body, hood, rack)


def grill_body():
    a = []

    def box(n, d, p, mat):
        o = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.rect(d[0], d[1]), d[2], both=True)
        o = s3d.at(o, x=p[0], y=p[1], z=p[2])
        s3d.material(o, mat[0], color=mat[1])
        a.append(o)

    S = ("steel", "#babfc7")
    D = ("steel", "#7a8087")
    B = ("painted_metal", "#1a1c1f")
    items = [
        ("bottom_pan", (660, 900, 20), (330, 0, 10), D),
        ("right_outer_wall", (660, 20, 300), (330, 430, 170), S),
        ("left_outer_wall", (660, 20, 340), (330, -430, 170), S),
        ("rear_outer_wall", (20, 900, 340), (10, 0, 170), S),
        ("front_fascia", (35, 900, 240), (642.5, 0, 120), S),
        ("rear_support_deck", (90, 770, 20), (60, 0, 320), S),
        ("front_support_deck", (80, 770, 20), (505, 0, 320), S),
        ("right_support_deck", (510, 60, 20), (335, 400, 320), S),
        ("left_support_deck", (510, 60, 20), (335, -400, 320), S),
        ("rear_top_rim", (60, 900, 24), (30, 0, 338), S),
        ("front_top_rim", (38, 900, 24), (641, 0, 338), S),
        ("right_top_rim", (567, 28, 24), (338.5, 436, 338), S),
        ("left_top_rim", (567, 28, 24), (338.5, -436, 338), S),
        ("firebox_floor", (510, 740, 15), (335, 0, 47.5), B),
        ("firebox_right_wall", (480, 15, 255), (320, 377.5, 182.5), B),
        ("firebox_left_wall", (480, 15, 255), (320, -377.5, 182.5), B),
        ("firebox_rear_wall", (15, 770, 255), (87.5, 0, 182.5), B),
        ("firebox_front_wall", (15, 740, 205), (577.5, 0, 157.5), B),
    ]
    for n, d, p, m in items:
        m = {"steel": S, "dark": D, "black": B}.get(m, m)
        box(n, d, p, m)
    for n, y in [("rack_pivot_boss_right", 370), ("rack_pivot_boss_left", -370)]:
        o = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.circle(16), 30, both=True)
        o = s3d.at(o, x=105, y=y, z=292, rx=90)
        s3d.material(o, "steel", color="#949499")
        a.append(o)
    return s3d.group("grill_body", *a)


def hood_part():
    a = []
    p = [
        (-10, -10),
        (0, 20),
        (80, 100),
        (245, 182),
        (430, 160),
        (565, 70),
        (585, -30),
        (545, -5),
        (500, 45),
        (405, 95),
        (230, 118),
        (30, 20),
        (0, -2),
    ]
    o = s3d.extrude("hood_shell", s3d.poly(p), 840, both=True)
    o = s3d.at(o, rx=90)
    s3d.material(o, "steel", color="#babfc7")
    a.append(o)

    def bx(n, d, x, y, z):
        q = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.rect(d[0], d[1]), d[2], both=True)
        q = s3d.at(q, x=x, y=y, z=z)
        s3d.material(q, "steel", color="#7a8087")
        a.append(q)

    for n, y in [("left_handle_standoff", -180), ("right_handle_standoff", 180)]:
        q = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.circle(20), 58, both=True)
        q = s3d.at(q, x=548, y=y, z=4, ry=90)
        s3d.material(q, "steel", color="#7a8087")
        a.append(q)
    bx("right_hood_hinge_ear", (32, 24, 55), 95, 392, -12.5)
    bx("left_hood_hinge_ear", (32, 24, 55), 95, -392, -12.5)
    bx("right_hood_endcap", (200, 30, 100), 150, 395, 45)
    bx("left_hood_endcap", (200, 30, 100), 150, -395, 45)
    q = s3d.extrude("hood_handle", s3d.circle(18), 420, both=True)
    q = s3d.at(q, x=586, z=4, rx=90)
    s3d.material(q, "steel", color="#7a8087")
    a.append(q)
    return s3d.group("hood", *a)


def warming_rack():
    a = []
    segs = {
        "rack_rear_bar": ((0, -355, 0), (0, 355, 0)),
        "rack_mid_bar_1": ((100, -300, -18), (100, 300, -18)),
        "rack_mid_bar_2": ((180, -282, -32), (180, 282, -32)),
        "rack_mid_bar_3": ((240, -268, -43), (240, 268, -43)),
        "rack_front_bar": ((305, -250, -48), (305, 250, -48)),
        "rack_side_left_1": ((0, -355, 0), (100, -300, -18)),
        "rack_side_left_2": ((100, -300, -18), (180, -282, -32)),
        "rack_side_left_3": ((180, -282, -32), (240, -268, -43)),
        "rack_side_left_4": ((240, -268, -43), (305, -250, -48)),
        "rack_side_right_1": ((0, 355, 0), (100, 300, -18)),
        "rack_side_right_2": ((100, 300, -18), (180, 282, -32)),
        "rack_side_right_3": ((180, 282, -32), (240, 268, -43)),
        "rack_side_right_4": ((240, 268, -43), (305, 250, -48)),
    }
    for n, (p, q) in segs.items():
        dx = q[0] - p[0]
        dy = q[1] - p[1]
        dz = q[2] - p[2]
        L = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
        ry = math.degrees(math.atan2(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), dz))
        rz = math.degrees(math.atan2(dy, dx))
        o = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.circle(7.6), L, both=True)
        o = s3d.at(o, x=(p[0] + q[0]) / 2, y=(p[1] + q[1]) / 2, z=(p[2] + q[2]) / 2, ry=ry, rz=rz)
        s3d.material(o, "steel", color="#949499")
        a.append(o)
    return s3d.group("warming_rack", *a)

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def folding_bike_crankset():
    bb = bottom_bracket()
    crank = crankset()
    f = s3d.local(bb)
    crank = s3d.at(crank, on=f)
    s3d.joint("bottom_bracket_spin", crank, f, kind="revolute", axis="+X", range=(-180, 180))
    fr = s3d.local(crank, 64, 0, -165)
    rp = s3d.at(right_pedal(), on=fr)
    s3d.joint("right_pedal_fold", rp, fr, kind="revolute", axis="+Y", range=(0, 91.67))
    fl = s3d.local(crank, -64, 0, 165)
    lp = s3d.at(left_pedal(), on=fl)
    s3d.joint("left_pedal_fold", lp, fl, kind="revolute", axis="+Y", range=(-91.67, 0))
    return s3d.assembly("folding_bike_crankset", bb, crank, rp, lp)


def bottom_bracket():
    shell = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(
            s3d.revolve("bb_shell", [(0, -38), (24, -38), (24, 38), (17, 38), (17, -38)]), ry=90
        ),
        "plastic",
        color="#242426",
    )
    a = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("left_cup", s3d.circle(54), 4, both=True), x=-40, ry=90),
        "steel",
        color="#737880",
    )
    b = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("right_cup", s3d.circle(54), 4, both=True), x=40, ry=90),
        "steel",
        color="#737880",
    )
    return s3d.group("bottom_bracket", shell, a, b)


def crankset():
    p = []

    def cyl(n, r, l, x=0, y=0, z=0, rx=0, ry=0, kind="steel", color="#737880"):
        return s3d.material(
            s3d.at(s3d.extrude(n, s3d.circle(2 * r), l, both=True), x=x, y=y, z=z, rx=rx, ry=ry),
            kind,
            color=color,
        )

    p += [
        cyl("spindle", 11, 94, ry=90),
        cyl("left_bearing", 17, 14, -28, ry=90),
        cyl("right_bearing", 17, 14, 28, ry=90),
        cyl("left_boss", 18, 18, -55, ry=90, kind="aluminium", color="#c2c7cc"),
        cyl("right_boss", 20, 18, 55, ry=90, kind="plastic", color="#242426"),
    ]
    p.append(
        s3d.material(
            s3d.at(
                s3d.extrude("chainring", s3d.circle(156) - s3d.circle(86), 4, both=True),
                x=46,
                ry=90,
            ),
            "plastic",
            color="#242426",
        )
    )
    for i, a in enumerate((0, 1.26, 2.51, 3.77, 5.03), 1):
        ob = s3d.extrude(f"spider_arm_{i}", s3d.rect(4, 50), 10, both=True)
        ob = s3d.at(ob, x=44, y=27 * math.sin(a), z=27 * math.cos(a), rx=90 + math.degrees(a))
        p.append(s3d.material(ob, "aluminium", color="#c2c7cc"))
    profile = [
        (-16, 0),
        (16, 0),
        (16, 20),
        (12, 72),
        (10, 147),
        (10, 165),
        (-10, 165),
        (-10, 147),
        (-12, 72),
        (-16, 20),
    ]
    arm = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("left_arm", s3d.poly(profile), 12, both=True), x=-53, rx=90, rz=90),
        "aluminium",
        color="#c2c7cc",
    )
    p.append(arm)
    other = s3d.copy(arm)
    other = s3d.transform(other, x=106, rx=180)
    other.name = "right_arm"
    p.append(other)
    for n, x, z in (("left_pedal_bridge", -58, 165), ("right_pedal_bridge", 58, -165)):
        p.append(
            s3d.material(
                s3d.at(s3d.extrude(n, s3d.rect(12, 12), 20, both=True), x=x, z=z),
                "aluminium",
                color="#c2c7cc",
            )
        )
    for n, x, z in (("left_hinge_pin", -64, 165), ("right_hinge_pin", 64, -165)):
        p.append(cyl(n, 4.5, 26, x=x, z=z, rx=90))
    return s3d.group("crankset", *p)


def right_pedal():
    return pedal("right_pedal", 1)


def left_pedal():
    return pedal("left_pedal", -1)


def pedal(name, sgn):
    b = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("hinge_barrel", s3d.circle(16), 26, both=True), rx=90),
        "plastic",
        color="#242426",
    )
    y = s3d.material(
        s3d.at(s3d.extrude("hinge_yoke", s3d.rect(14, 22), 18, both=True), x=sgn * 9),
        "aluminium",
        color="#c2c7cc",

import sand3d as s3d

def rugged_folding_stick_vacuum():
    u = upper_assembly()
    l = lower_wand()
    h = floor_head()
    t = trigger_part()
    f = s3d.local(u)
    l = s3d.at(l, on=f)
    s3d.joint("fold_joint", l, f, kind="revolute", axis="+Y", range=(0, math.degrees(1.55)))
    f = s3d.local(l, 30, 0, -785)
    h = s3d.at(h, on=f)
    s3d.joint(
        "head_pivot",
        h,
        f,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="+Y",
        range=(math.degrees(-0.55), math.degrees(0.65)),
    )
    f = s3d.local(u, -105, 0, 660)
    t = s3d.at(t, on=f)
    s3d.joint("trigger_pivot", t, f, kind="revolute", axis="+Y", range=(0, math.degrees(0.32)))
    return s3d.assembly("rugged_folding_stick_vacuum", u, l, h, t)

import sand3d as s3d
import math


def office_router():
    housing = housing_part()
    cover_frame = s3d.local(housing, 67, -90, 18, 0, 0, 0)
    usb_cover = s3d.at(usb_cover_part(), on=cover_frame)
    s3d.joint(
        "housing_to_usb_cover",
        usb_cover,
        cover_frame,
        kind="revolute",
        axis="-Z",
        range=(0, math.degrees(1.95)),
    )
    for name, x in (("antenna_left", -85), ("antenna_center", 0), ("antenna_right", 85)):
        f = s3d.local(housing, x, 83, 41.5)
        child = s3d.at(antenna_part(name), on=f)
        s3d.joint(
            "housing_to_" + name,
            child,
            f,
            kind="revolute",
            axis="-X",
            range=(math.degrees(-1.20), math.degrees(1.10)),
        )
        if name == "antenna_left":
            left = child
        elif name == "antenna_center":
            center = child
        else:
            right = child
    return s3d.assembly("office_router", housing, usb_cover, left, center, right)


def housing_part():
    c = s3d.material
    a = s3d.material(
        s3d.extrude("top_shell", s3d.rect(260, 180), 3, both=True), "plastic", color="#26292b"
    )
    a = s3d.at(a, z=34.5)
    b = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("left_wall", s3d.rect(2.5, 180), 33, both=True), x=-128.75, z=16.5)
    d = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("right_wall", s3d.rect(2.5, 180), 33, both=True), x=128.75, z=16.5)
    e = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("front_wall", s3d.rect(255, 2.5), 33, both=True), y=-88.75, z=16.5)
    f = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("rear_wall", s3d.rect(255, 2.5), 33, both=True), y=88.75, z=16.5)
    g = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("bottom_shell", s3d.rect(255, 175), 2.5, both=True), z=1.25)
    pieces = [a, b, d, e, f, g]

    def addbox(n, dims, pos, col):
        ob = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.rect(dims[0], dims[1]), dims[2], both=True)
        ob = s3d.at(ob, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2])
        return s3d.material(ob, "plastic", color=col)

    pieces.append(addbox("rear_spine", (220, 24, 8), (0, 78, 32), "#1c1f21"))
    for n, x in (("left_mount", -85), ("center_mount", 0), ("right_mount", 85)):
        pieces.append(addbox(n, (30, 14, 6), (x, 83, 33), "#1c1f21"))
    pieces.append(addbox("usb_port_body", (24, 5, 11), (80, -87.5, 18), "#080809"))
    pieces.append(addbox("usb_bezel", (36, 1.2, 23), (80, -90.6, 18), "#1c1f21"))
    for n, x, y in (
        ("foot_front_left", -90, -60),
        ("foot_front_right", 90, -60),
        ("foot_rear_left", -90, 60),
        ("foot_rear_right", 90, 60),
    ):
        pieces.append(addbox(n, (24, 14, 3), (x, y, -1.5), "#1c1f21"))
    return s3d.group("housing", *pieces)


def usb_cover_part():
    panel = s3d.extrude("cover_panel", s3d.rect(26, 3), 15, both=True)
    panel = s3d.at(panel, x=13, y=-1.5)
    panel = s3d.material(panel, "plastic", color="#1c1f21")
    pin = s3d.extrude("hinge_knuckle", s3d.circle(3), 15, both=True)
    pin = s3d.at(pin, y=-1.5)
    pin = s3d.material(pin, "plastic", color="#1c1f21")
    return s3d.group("usb_cover", panel, pin)


def antenna_part(name):
    col = "#141416"
    bar = s3d.extrude("hinge_barrel", s3d.circle(11), 26, both=True)
    bar = s3d.at(bar, ry=90)
    neck = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("neck", s3d.rect(10, 6), 18, both=True), z=10)
    blade = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("blade", s3d.rect(20, 8), 95, both=True), z=65.5)
    cap = s3d.extrude("tip_cap", s3d.circle(20), 20, both=True)
    cap = s3d.at(cap, z=113, ry=90)
    return s3d.group(
        name, *[s3d.material(v, "plastic", color=col) for v in (bar, neck, blade, cap)]
    )

import sand3d as s3d


def screw_cap_bottle():
    bottle = bottle_part()
    f = s3d.local(bottle, 0, 0, 205)
    cap = s3d.at(cap_part(), on=f)
    s3d.joint("neck_to_cap", cap, f, kind="continuous", axis="+Z")
    return s3d.assembly("screw_cap_bottle", bottle, cap)


def bottle_part(body_radius=55, body_height=130, neck_radius=20, neck_top=228):
    # Lathed bottle wall: exterior followed back down the interior, with flat ends.
    profile = [
        (48, 0),
        (55, 8),
        (55, 130),
        (50, 145),
        (32, 166),
        (22, 181),
        (20, 228),
        (16, 224),
        (16, 179),
        (27, 158),
        (44, 139),
        (49, 126),
        (49, 14),
        (36, 6),
    ]
    shell = s3d.revolve("bottle_shell", profile)
    shell = s3d.material(shell, "plastic", color="#8ccfff", opacity=0.42)
    ring = s3d.at(s3d.extrude("neck_support_ring", s3d.circle(58), 7, both=True), z=201.5)
    ring = s3d.material(ring, "plastic", color="#b8ebff", opacity=0.58)
    # A fine helical wire approximates the moulded screw bead.
    path = s3d.helix(43.7, 11.5, 35)
    thread = s3d.at(s3d.wire("neck_thread", path, 2.8), z=183)
    thread = s3d.material(thread, "plastic", color="#b8ebff", opacity=0.58)
    return s3d.group("bottle", shell, ring, thread)


def cap_part(cap_height=60, wall_height=50, outer_diameter=74, inner_diameter=52):
    shell = s3d.tube("cap_shell", outer_diameter, inner_diameter, wall_height)
    top = s3d.at(s3d.cylinder("cap_top", outer_diameter, cap_height - wall_height), z=wall_height)
    cap = s3d.join(shell, top)
    cap = s3d.material(cap, "plastic", color="#f0f0e6")
    return s3d.group("cap", cap)

        upper,

items.program:
import sand3d as s3d
import math


def drill_press_cross_slide_vise():
    base = _base()
    xw = _wheel("x")
    xw = s3d.at(xw, on=s3d.local(base, x=-198, z=31))
    base = s3d.group("base", base, xw)
    stage = _stage()
    yw = _wheel("y")
    yw = s3d.at(yw, on=s3d.local(stage, y=-106, z=19))
    stage = s3d.group("x_stage", stage, yw)
    jaw = _jaw()
    f = s3d.local(base, z=48)
    stage = s3d.at(stage, on=f)
    s3d.joint("base_to_x_stage", stage, f, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(-34, 34))
    g = s3d.local(stage, z=20)
    jaw = s3d.at(jaw, on=g)
    s3d.joint("x_stage_to_y_jaw", jaw, g, kind="prismatic", axis="+Y", range=(-14, 10))
    return s3d.assembly("drill_press_cross_slide_vise", base, stage, jaw)


def _box(n, s, p, c, r=(0, 0, 0)):
    o = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.rect(s[0], s[1]), s[2], both=True)
    o = s3d.at(
        o,
        x=p[0],
        y=p[1],
        z=p[2],
        rx=math.degrees(r[0]),
        ry=math.degrees(r[1]),
        rz=math.degrees(r[2]),
    )
    return s3d.material(o, "plastic", color=c)


def _cyl(n, r, h, p, t, c):
    o = s3d.extrude(n, s3d.circle(2 * r), h, both=True)
    o = s3d.at(
        o,
        x=p[0],
        y=p[1],
        z=p[2],
        rx=math.degrees(t[0]),
        ry=math.degrees(t[1]),
        rz=math.degrees(t[2]),
    )
    return s3d.material(o, "steel", color=c)


def _group(n, a):
    return s3d.group(n, *a)


def _base():
    d = "#303d42"
    c = "#4c666b"
    m = "#babfc4"
    a = [
        _box("foot", (340, 170, 14), (0, 0, 7), d),
        _box("table", (292, 146, 16), (0, 0, 22), c),
        _box("dovetail_lower", (288, 94, 8), (0, 0, 34), m),
        _box("dovetail_upper", (288, 52, 8), (0, 0, 42), m),
        _box("dovetail_left_bevel", (288, 6, 14), (0, -36, 38), m, (-math.radians(35), 0, 0)),
        _box("dovetail_right_bevel", (288, 6, 14), (0, 36, 38), m, (math.radians(35), 0, 0)),
        _box("x_screw_lug", (26, 30, 22), (-153, 0, 31), c),
        _cyl("x_screw_boss", 7.5, 20, (-176, 0, 31), (0, math.pi / 2, 0), m),
    ]
    return _group("base_part", a)


def _teeth(a, name, prefix, x, z, yc, zc, t, d, n, sgn):
    a.append(_box(name, (x, t, z), (0, yc, zc), "#babfc4"))
    pitch = x / (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        a.append(
            _box(
                f"{prefix}_{i + 1}",
                (pitch * 0.42, d, z),
                (-x / 2 + pitch * (i + 1), yc + sgn * (t / 2 + d / 2 - 0.1), zc),
                "#1f1f21",
            )
        )


def _stage():
    c = "#4c666b"
    d = "#303d42"
    m = "#babfc4"
    a = [
        _box("bridge", (228, 134, 14), (0, 0, 7), c),
        _box("left_shoe", (224, 18, 18), (0, -58, -9), d),
        _box("right_shoe", (224, 18, 18), (0, 58, -9), d),
        _box("top_rail_left", (22, 112, 6), (-33, -6, 17), m),
        _box("top_rail_right", (22, 112, 6), (33, -6, 17), m),
        _box("fixed_jaw_body", (118, 20, 66), (0, 59, 47), c),
    ]
    _teeth(a, "fixed_jaw_face", "fixed_tooth", 96, 42, 47.5, 47, 3, 1.5, 9, -1)
    a.extend(
        [
            _box("y_screw_lug", (24, 26, 12), (0, -79, 19), c),
            _cyl("y_screw_boss", 6, 18, (0, -93, 19), (math.pi / 2, 0, 0), m),
        ]
    )
    return _group("stage_part", a)


def _jaw():
    c = "#4c666b"
    m = "#babfc4"
    a = [
        _box("runner_left", (22, 84, 6), (-33, -6, 3), m),
        _box("runner_right", (22, 84, 6), (33, -6, 3), m),
        _box("carriage", (106, 92, 12), (0, -6, 12), c),
        _box("moving_jaw_body", (112, 18, 42), (0, 29, 39), c),
    ]
    _teeth(a, "moving_jaw_face", "moving_tooth", 96, 42, 18.5, 39, 3, 1.5, 9, 1)
    return _group("jaw_part", a)


def _wheel(axis):
    m = "#babfc4"
    o = "#1f1f21"
    b = "#141416"
    a = []
    if axis == "x":
        r = (0, math.pi / 2, 0)
        q = (6, 0, 0)
        rr = [(2, 0, 0), (5, 0, 0), (8, 0, 0)]
        sp = [
            ("spoke_main", (2.4, 26, 2.4), (0, 0, 0)),
            ("spoke_diag_a", (2.4, 20, 2.4), (math.radians(52), 0, 0)),
            ("spoke_diag_b", (2.4, 20, 2.4), (-math.radians(52), 0, 0)),
        ]
        arm = ((0, 13.5, 0), (2.6, 11, 2.6))
        kn = ((0, 20.2, 0), r)
    else:
        r = (math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
        q = (0, 6, 0)
        rr = [(0, 2, 0), (0, 5, 0), (0, 8, 0)]

import sand3d as s3d


def side_wall_telescoping_boom():
    support = side_support()
    outer = s3d.at(outer_sleeve(), on=s3d.local(support, 60, 0, 1220))
    middle_frame = s3d.local(outer, 700, 0, 0)
    middle = s3d.at(middle_section(), on=middle_frame)
    s3d.joint("outer_to_middle", middle, middle_frame, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 340))
    inner_frame = s3d.local(middle, 340, 0, 0)
    inner = s3d.at(inner_section(), on=inner_frame)
    s3d.joint("middle_to_inner", inner, inner_frame, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 280))
    tip_frame = s3d.local(inner, 280, 0, 0)
    tip = s3d.at(tip_section(), on=tip_frame)
    s3d.joint("inner_to_tip", tip, tip_frame, kind="prismatic", axis="+X", range=(0, 220))
    return s3d.assembly("side_wall_telescoping_boom", support, outer, middle, inner, tip)


def box(name, size, pos, color, kind="painted_metal"):
    ob = s3d.extrude(name, s3d.rect(size[0], size[1]), size[2], both=True)
    ob = s3d.at(ob, x=pos[0], y=pos[1], z=pos[2])
    return s3d.material(ob, kind, color=color)


def side_support():
    items = []
    for n, sz, p in [
        ("wall_plate", (80, 720, 1650), (-40, 0, 825)),
        ("floor_foot", (300, 860, 80), (-20, 0, 40)),
        ("backing_pad", (65, 360, 250), (27.5, 0, 1220)),
        ("lower_cradle", (460, 200, 35), (280, 0, 1142.5)),
        ("side_cheek_0", (340, 18, 180), (255, 92, 1220)),
        ("side_cheek_1", (340, 18, 180), (255, -92, 1220)),
        ("upper_bridge", (85, 250, 35), (45, 0, 1312.5)),
        ("lower_gusset_0", (380, 24, 55), (220, 145, 1075)),
        ("lower_gusset_1", (380, 24, 55), (220, -145, 1075)),
    ]:
        items.append(box(n, sz, p, "#1a1f24"))
    for i, (y, z) in enumerate([(-260, 240), (260, 240), (-260, 1480), (260, 1480)]):
        b = s3d.extrude("bolt_head_%d" % i, s3d.circle(50), 12, both=True)
        b = s3d.at(b, x=4, y=y, z=z, ry=90)
        items.append(s3d.material(b, "steel", color="#8c9490"))
    return s3d.group("side_support", *items)


def tube(name, x0, x1, oy, oz, iy, iz, color):
    length = x1 - x0
    x = (x0 + x1) / 2
    ty = (oy - iy) / 2
    tz = (oz - iz) / 2
    walls = [
        box(name, (length, oy, tz), (x, 0, (oz + iz) / 4), color, "steel"),
        box(name, (length, oy, tz), (x, 0, -(oz + iz) / 4), color, "steel"),
        box(name, (length, ty, iz), (x, (oy + iy) / 4, 0), color, "steel"),
        box(name, (length, ty, iz), (x, -(oy + iy) / 4, 0), color, "steel"),
    ]
    return s3d.join(walls[0], *walls[1:])


def outer_sleeve():

        "outer_sleeve",

def inner_section():

        box("upper_guide_pad", (120, 52, 2), (-360, 0, 24), "#040506", "rubber"),
        box("lower_guide_pad", (120, 52, 2), (-360, 0, -24), "#040506", "rubber"),

def tip_section():
    return s3d.group(
        "tip_section",
        box("tip_bar", (560, 46, 28), (-40, 0, 0), "#9ea8aa", "steel"),
        box("front_stop", (35, 64, 42), (247.5, 0, 0), "#040506"),
        box("side_guide_pad_0", (100, 6, 16), (-280, 26, 0), "#040506", "rubber"),
